subject: physics
question_text: Give an example where the velocity of an object is zero but the acceleration is not zero.

verification.note: Unit 3 has NO Long Answer section in either source book. The Fastrack (pp.6-8) lists 4 Very Short Answer and 6 Short Answer questions; the TSBIE Basic Learning Material (pp.4-5) has a Short Answer section ONLY and no VSAQ section at all. So this VSAQ is the Fastrack’s alone. The 1+1 mark split is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question
Motion in a Straight Line · 2 marks

steps.label: The example
lines: A body thrown vertically upwards, at the
There its velocity v = 0, because it has
stopped rising and has not yet fallen.
steps.why: The velocity passes through zero because it changes sign from upward to downward. Passing through zero takes only an instant.
common_mistakes: Giving a body at rest on a table. There both velocity and acceleration are zero.

recall.must_convey: That at the highest point of a body thrown vertically upwards the velocity is zero.
reject: body at rest on a table

steps.memory_tip: At the top the velocity is changing SIGN, so it passes through zero for an instant.
steps.margin_note: Name the highest point exactly. "Somewhere in flight" is not enough.

steps.label: Why a is not zero

lines.text: Gravity still acts, so a = g downwards

lines: Acceleration depends on the force acting,
not on the value of the velocity. Nothing
switches gravity off at the top.
steps.why: Acceleration is the RATE of change of velocity. The velocity is zero for one instant but is changing quickly, so its rate of change is large.
common_mistakes: Saying acceleration is zero because velocity is zero. The two are independent at any instant.

recall.must_convey: That the acceleration equals g downwards because gravity still acts, and acceleration does not depend on the value of the velocity.

steps.memory_tip: Zero velocity does not mean zero acceleration. Gravity does not pause at the top.
steps.margin_note: Say what still acts: gravity. That is the mark.

insider_note: A 3-star cell. The example alone is half the answer — say WHY the acceleration survives at that instant.
